metadata.document: Reform of the Oceans Management System

cleaned_body_text: Options for the future. The conceptualisation above is by no means perfect, partly reflecting the pragmatism and messiness that defines a system that has evolved over time in response to emerging issues, changing values and political possibilities. It is not always obvious which lenses have been laid down first, and which have been left to fill gaps. However, the idea of layering legislative lenses provides a conceptual starting point for considering future options.
